name: since_close_stop_advice_reconcile_20261109
comment: LQ-20261107-1644 (operator 13:29 ET): the Home 'Your actions' card rendered a 12:01 ET
brief while the header's AS OF was the 1:17 check time, and all three rows it still asked
for had working stops at 2:00 PM ET. The advice is built once per brief run; the stop book
moves without it. Pins: each row is reconciled against the newest stop_last_known read
(working status only; coverage per account; the brief's one-share rounding tolerance); a
done row leaves the actions and says which working stop answers it; an unread book marks
every ask unread and claims no as-of; the as-of text is the STOPS source's clock, never the
check time; a newer broker read rebuilds the snapshot with no model call; a caller that
passes no stop read gets the brief untouched. Stub DB / synthetic AAA rows.
